Messages.Author: Kimmo Lindman
Messages.Body:
Bonecraft Card Text:
Strike: 1 damage Put this card on the opposing minion. The minion with
this card has -1 hand damage. (This does not affect the Strike Resolution
step this round.) He or she may burn this card by paying 2 blood as a +1
stealth action (S) As above, but the minion with this card has -2 hand
damage.

The following situation came up in our game. Horatio hit Uriah Winter with
Bonecraft (inf), Uriah prevented the damage with Skin of Rock (inf). The
opposing Methuselah argued that since she prevented the damage the
additional effects of the Bonecraft strike were cancelled also. I argued
that they were not cancelled, only the damage was reduced to zero, and
that she could only cancel the additional effects of Bonecraft by Dodge or
S:CE. Was I right or wrong?
I guess that this question applies also to other cards with additional
effects to damage like Blood Rage, Blood Fury, Soul Burn (when their
damage is prevented by other than fortitude cards) and Fleshcraft?

Kimmo

> that they were not cancelled, only the damage was reduced to zero, and
> that she could only cancel the additional effects of Bonecraft by Dodge or
> S:CE. Was I right or wrong?

You are right. Damage prevent prevents damage. It does not prevent non-damage
effects (like steal blood, destroy weapon, etc.)
